info.name: BigCommerce Abandoned Cart Emails Webhooks Admin API

params.name: is_active
params.description: Enables user to filter for webhooks that are active or not. A webhook subscription becomes deactivated after 90 days of inactivity.

items.docs: List all notification emails, webhooks, and denylisted domains associated with the API account.

Update email addresses that are sent notification emails when any domain associated with the API account is denylisted or when a webhook is deactivated. Supports `upsert` functionality in the case that no email address exists yet.
